events.verdict: Randle (NOP) briefly grasps Temple's (MEM) shorts as he rolls out of his screening position, but the contact is marginal and does not affect Temple's FOM.
Green (MEM) and Randle (NOP) engage and disengage along the perimeter without affecting the other's FOM.
Temple (MEM) holds Randle's (NOP) left arm and wraps his midsection as they roll through the lane.
Hill (NOP) places his left hand to Anderson's (MEM) right arm and makes marginal contact that does not affect his SQBR.
Anderson (MEM) makes inadvertent contact with Randle (NOP) on his follow-through.
Conley (MEM) makes marginal contact with Moore's (NOP) backside that does not affect his FOM.
LAR/LLB show Gasol (MEM) makes contact with Davis' (NOP) right forearm during his upward shooting motion, affecting his jump shot attempt.
Randle (NOP) engages with Green (MEM) as the shot is released and disengages without affecting his ability to retrieve the rebound.
[Observable in enhanced video] Randle (NOP) is in the lane for longer than three seconds without actively guarding an opponent.
Moore (NOP) places his hand to Temple's (MEM) midsection and makes contact that is tactile in nature.
Davis (NOP) sets the pick on Conley (MEM) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
As he attempts to get around the screen, Temple (MEM) reaches back and subsequently makes inadvertent contact with Hill's (NOP) upper body.
Randle (NOP) hops consecutively on the same foot upon ending his dribble.
Anderson (MEM) cleanly dislodges Randle (NOP) of the ball at the end of his drive.
Green (MEM) maintains legal guarding position as marginal contact is made with Randle (NOP) at the end of his drive.
Conley (MEM) reflexively places his hand to Davis' (NOP) midsection and makes contact that is tactile in nature.
Moore (NOP) creates contact with Conley (MEM) that dislodges him from his legally obtained position.
Davis (NOP) sets the pick on Conley (MEM) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Conley (MEM) makes marginal contact with Holiday (NOP) during the drive that does not affect his SQBR.
Holiday (NOP) makes clean contact with the ball as Green (MEM) attempts to recover the rebound.
Miller (NOP) commits a take foul on Anderson (MEM).
